{"subject":"Quick hello from Harbor Street","body":"Hi,

I've been thinking about Fly.io lately and wanted to check in to see how things are going for you and the team.

If it would be useful, I'd be glad to set up a 20-minute call whenever it suits you. I'm happy to listen, compare notes on what you're seeing in the market, or just catch up.

No agenda and no pressure. Hope the year is treating you well.

Best,
Sam"}
